title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: Arterial Blood Pressure (ABP), ECG, PPG waveform feature extraction R. abpwaveforms R package provides reproducible, Rcpp-accelerated tools cardiovascular waveform analysis. Inspired MATLAB BPannotate, extracts key hemodynamic features ABP, ECG, PPG signals.

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: 📉 Fiducials: foot (onset), systolic peak, dicrotic notch/peak ⚡ Features: Pulse pressure (PP), Augmentation Index (AIx), Reflected Wave Transit Time (RWTT), Pulse Arrival Time (PAT), Heart Rate (HR), max dV/dt, PPG amplitude/rise time/half-width, dicrotic timing & amplitude 🚀 Fast Rcpp backend resampling, derivatives, peak/notch detection
